summary: Tested NEW reset-master-password feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_reset.py with 10 tests covering DELETE /api/auth/reset (success, is_setup toggles to false, DB collections wiped, old password rejected, re-setup works, new login works, idempotent on empty DB). Full suite: 23/23 passed sequentially. Frontend (mobile viewport 375x667): (1) After setup with TestPass123, root routes to /login. (2) 'Password dimenticata? Reset' link renders with testID=forgot-password-button. (3) Tapping it opens the confirmation Modal showing 'Attenzione!', warning text and both buttons (danger 'Sì, cancella tutto' and 'Annulla'). (4) Annulla dismisses modal. (5) 'Sì, cancella tutto' triggers DELETE /api/auth/reset, clears local auth state and redirects to /setup (Benvenuto screen). (6) Creating NewPass456 in setup redirects directly to /home (empty vault). (7) Backend /api/auth/check returns is_setup:true again, login with old TestPass123 → 401, login with NewPass456 → 200. Every acceptance criterion from the review request is met. Only observation: existing react-native-web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props, 'props.pointerEvents') still surface in console — non-blocking, previously reported.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"'. Previously reported; non-blocking.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (surfaces on Modal). Non-blocking.

action_items: None required for the reset feature — it works end-to-end.
(Low priority carry-over) Migrate deprecated shadow*/pointerEvents props to boxShadow/style.pointerEvents to silence RN-Web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend DELETE /api/auth/reset is a destructive endpoint with no auth guard. That is intentional per the product decision (user forgot master password), but it means anyone who can reach the API can wipe the vault. Consider adding a client-generated 'reset token' shown only during setup, or a rate limit, before shipping to production.
AuthContext.resetAllData correctly clears masterPassword, isAuthenticated, isSetup, isBiometricEnabled, biometric_enabled flag and the secure master_password entry — no residual state leaks.
server.py uses datetime.utcnow() which is deprecated in Python 3.12+. Not a bug today but flag for future maintenance.
seed_data_creation: Reset MongoDB collections then POST /api/auth/setup with TestPass123 to prime the login screen. After frontend flow, master password is now NewPass456 (change if next iteration expects TestPass123).
context_for_next_testing_agent: After this iteration, the ACTIVE master password is 'NewPass456' (not TestPass123). To reset for next testing, run: mongosh --eval 'db=db.getSiblingDB("test_database"); db.users.deleteMany({}); db.password_entries.deleteMany({});'. Frontend URL: https://password-vault-167.preview.emergentagent.com. Reset endpoint: DELETE /api/auth/reset. Frontend testIDs added: forgot-password-button, confirm-reset-button, cancel-reset-button. Backend pytest must be invoked with -o addopts="" to disable xdist because tests share global DB state (pytest.ini enables -n auto by default which caused non-deterministic ordering failures during initial run).
rca_of_issue: Not a bug — feature validation. Original user pain: from mobile, if master password was forgotten there was no recovery path. Implemented reset flow (backend DELETE /api/auth/reset + frontend link/modal in login.tsx + resetAllData in AuthContext) works exactly as designed and covers the full user journey.
